    -- Prove that f is injective
    intro a₁ a₂ h
    by_cases hα : Nonempty α
    · -- Case: α is nonempty
      have h_inv : Function.LeftInverse (f_inv hα) f := hf hα
      have h₁ : f_inv hα (f a₁) = a₁ := h_inv a₁
      have h₂ : f_inv hα (f a₂) = a₂ := h_inv a₂
      have h₃ : f_inv hα (f a₁) = f_inv hα (f a₂) := by rw [h]
      rw [h₁, h₂] at h₃
      exact h₃
    · -- Case: α is empty
      -- This case is impossible because hα : ¬Nonempty α and we have a₁ : α, which implies Nonempty α
      exfalso
      exact hα ⟨a₁⟩
  )
